syllabus_extract: Introduction to sonar system. Purpose and technical details of active and passive sonar system.
specific_objectives: 26.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the basic theory of communication.

intro_questions: What is the primary function of a sonar system?
Define the basic theory of communication in underwater contexts.
List two key differences between active and passive sonar.

summary_questions: Explain the operational principle of an active sonar pulse.
Describe how passive sonar detects targets without emitting sound.
Identify three environmental factors that degrade sonar accuracy.
